name: Youth
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of guiding youth to live according to God's Word, emphasizing purity and trust in the Lord rather than relying on their own understanding. Young people are encouraged to cleanse their ways by adhering to God's commands and to give their hearts fully to Him, recognizing that their actions are subject to divine judgment. The imagery of youth as growing plants and polished cornerstones underscores the value of spiritual growth and refinement during this formative stage of life.
